summary: Fidelity Private Credit Company LLC filed an 8-K to disclose a second amendment to its senior secured revolving credit facility. The amendment increases aggregate lender commitments from $430 million to $600 million, extends the maturity date to August 2031, extends the commitment termination date, raises the accordion capacity to $900 million, and eliminates credit spread adjustments on dollar and foreign-currency loans. This is a routine credit-facility modification, not a special-situation transaction. The registrant is the borrower. No equity, acquisition, capital-return, or restructuring elements are present, and no special-situation category applies.
